title: An H2 section should contain at least one file-list item

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: H2 sections are "file lists" of links -- zero or more markdown sections (h2) delimited by H2 headers, containing a list of URLs.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false. This id is a warn, not a fail, on disk today (check-security-txt.mjs precedent for the analogous decision does not apply here -- llmstxt.org genuinely has no conformance concept for an empty H2 section, so warn stays warn; rule_class: convention permits either severity). Recalled from training-data familiarity with the public page, not re-verified against a live fetch this session.

applicability: An H2 section whose body contains no list items at all.
expectation: Every H2 section has at least one line matching /^[-*]\s+/.

cases.name: an H2 section with prose but no list
